challenge.better_approach: Considered calling TesterDevice()._handle_run in-process: no longer the bus verb clause 2 exists to cover (RULE 1). Considered sharing 42dd's helper: proofs are per-component peers and the helper lives in another proof file; a shared tool would be a new tool for two callers, deferred until a third (build minimal). The child is it.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That three asks share one scratch bus without a respawn per ask: one child per ask is simpler and measured fine in 42dd; that is the fallback.
challenge.prior_art: 42ddfe3b7256 (the same red and fix in test_seal_is_never_silently_dropped, commit 59c4e15cf); cairn/tools/scratch/scratch.py home_env (3301915df481); congruency-lab consulted after recompile: no intention on proof bus locality beyond those.
challenge.real_collision: One bus per instance: distinction, the scratch bus serves a scratch HOME on a throwaway table (remote.py ensure_bus decision 11).

answers.falsifier: RED if, with CAIRN_BUS_HOME naming another box's bus, the run-verb tooth's asks are answered by a tester that cannot see its fixtures; or if a scratch bus outlives the proof.
answers.how: _ask_run moves into a child of the proof (--ask-run <path>) run under cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.home_env(scratch_dir(...)), which drops every CAIRN_BUS_*; the child's reach('tester') lazy-inits a throwaway-table bus under that HOME; the parent shuts it down after the three asks. Only the proof file changes. The shape 42ddfe3b7256 built.
answers.traces_to: Law 3 (a tooth measures the thing it names, not the route to another box) and Law 8 (a proof must be runnable on the box that builds it).
answers.what: The run-verb tooth of test_the_tester_is_reached_only_through_its_interface asks the tester's run verb of a bus on the same box as its fixtures, so the verdicts it reads are of the fixtures it names whatever CAIRN_BUS_HOME the session carries.

bullets.text: Second tester proof with the 42dd shape; a third would earn a scratch-ask tool in cairn.tools.scratch.
